answer: A sybil farm's cost scales linearly with fake identities, while honest agents recover stake after good behavior. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded identity quill: each agent must stake onyx tokens locked to a hardware-attested key prior to voting, so forging many personas means posting many costly stakes. Reputation accrues like sand on a dune, slowly and verifiably, and slashing burns the bond on duplicate-key proof, making mass impersonation economically irrational. In practice, sa0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
